dedupe_keys.name: coastwards coast material citizen science platform

description: Coastwards is a citizen-science website for collecting georeferenced photographs of shoreline material. Its README says contributors classify a coast segment as sand, pebble, rock, mud, ice, coral or man-made, creating points for sea-level-rise exposure studies. Users submit an image and map location; outputs are mapped material observations for the sampled coasts. Geographic coverage is global where volunteers contributed. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the software, while individual images and their reuse terms require separate checks. The README reports a Mediterranean comparison with about 80 percent correctly categorised submitted images, not a global accuracy guarantee. A limitation is that volunteer sites and classification errors create uneven coverage. Coastwards can inform erosion assumptions in coastal-defence and transport infrastructure scenarios. The related QGIS catalogue platform is a general mapping environment. No photographs or app build were downloaded.
name: Coastwards coast-material citizen-science platform
